question.text: Let an ant starts from the origin <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> and travels <math><mn>2</mn></math> units on negative <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>-axis, <math><mn>3</mn></math> units on positive <math><mi>y</mi></math>-axis and travels <math><mn>3</mn></math> units on negative <math><mi>z</mi></math>-axis to reach at point <math><mi>A</mi></math>. If <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> be such that the resultant of <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></math> is <math><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math>, then <math><msup><mrow><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>O</mi><mi>A</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>a</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>×</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>b</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> is equal to

solution.text:
OA→=-2i^+3j^-3k^,a→=i^-3j^+2k^
a→+b→=3i^-4j^+k^ (given)
⇒b→=2i^-j^-k^
OA→×a→×b→=OA→⋅b→a→-OA→⋅a→b→
=-4a→+17b→
=-4i^-3j^+2k^+172i^-j^-k^
=30i^-5j^-25k^
OA→×a→×b→2=900+25+625=1550
